    "FullName",
    "Username",
    "Email",
    "IsActive",
        CASE
            WHEN "UserType"::text = 'Collector'::text THEN 'Collector'::character varying
            WHEN "Role" = 1 THEN 'Head'::character varying
            WHEN "Role" = 2 THEN 'Admin'::character varying
            ELSE "UserType"
        END AS "AccountType"
   FROM "Users" u;
